questions.q: Under PD 1096 (National Building Code), what is the minimum clear width required for a main door?
questions.n: This is the standard minimum width for doors in the NBC to ensure adequate passage and furniture movement.

questions.q: For a second-floor room that is naturally ventilated, what is the minimum ceiling height requirement according to PD 1096?
questions.n: For natural ventilation, the NBC requires a consistent 2.70m height to allow for proper air circulation and heat dissipation.

questions.q: What is the maximum riser height permitted for stairs under BP 220 (Socialized and Economic Housing)?
questions.n: BP 220 allows for steeper stairs with a maximum riser of 250mm to save space in socialized housing units.

questions.q: According to RA 9514 (Fire Code), what is the occupant load factor for a 'Place of Assembly' with concentrated use (without fixed seats)?
questions.n: This factor is used for high-density areas like dance floors or standing-room-only assembly areas.

questions.q: Under BP 344 (Accessibility Law), what is the preferred height for a door knob from the finished floor line?
questions.n: While the allowable range is 820mm to 1060mm, 900mm is explicitly stated as the preferred height for accessibility.

questions.q: What is the minimum area required for a kitchen under the National Building Code (PD 1096)?
questions.n: The NBC mandates a minimum of 3.00 sqm for kitchens to ensure enough space for basic food preparation and storage.

questions.q: For a ramp to be compliant with BP 344, what is the maximum allowable gradient (slope)?
questions.n: A 1:12 slope (8.33%) is the maximum steepness allowed for a ramp to be safely navigated by a wheelchair user.

questions.q: According to the Fire Code (RA 9514), what is the maximum length of a dead-end corridor in a Healthcare occupancy?
questions.n: Healthcare occupancies are strictly limited to 6.00m dead ends due to the difficulty of evacuating patients.

questions.q: What is the minimum required distance of eaves from the property line according to PD 1096?
questions.n: The NBC requires at least 750mm of clearance between the eave and the property line to prevent encroachment and fire spread.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, how many exits are required for a floor with an occupant load of 600?
questions.n: For an occupant load of 500-999, the NBC requires at least 3 separate exits.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, what is the minimum air space requirement per person for a habitable room?
questions.n: This is the minimum volume of air required for each occupant in a standard habitable room to ensure proper health and comfort.

questions.q: According to RA 9514 (Fire Code), what is the minimum tread depth for a 'new' stair?
questions.n: The Fire Code mandates a deeper tread for new constructions to provide a safer and more stable footing during emergencies.

questions.q: What is the required 'Side Setback' for a residential R-1 property under PD 1096?
questions.n: For R-1 (Single-Detached) zones, a 2.00m side setback is required to maintain fire separation and privacy between neighbors.

questions.q: Under BP 220, what is the minimum door width for a bathroom?
questions.n: In socialized housing, bathroom doors are allowed to be as narrow as 0.60m to maximize the limited floor area available.

questions.q: For a building with an occupant load of 50 people, what is the minimum stair width required by PD 1096?
questions.n: The NBC specifies that for an occupant load of 10 to 50, the minimum stair width must be 0.90m.

questions.q: What is the occupant load factor for a 'Classroom' under RA 9514 (Fire Code)?
questions.n: The Fire Code uses 1.90 sqm per person for classrooms, which is slightly more conservative than the Building Code.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, what is the minimum ceiling height for the ground floor of a building with natural ventilation?
questions.n: Naturally ventilated rooms require a 2.70m ceiling to facilitate air movement and cooling.

questions.q: What is the maximum vertical distance between stair landings under PD 1096?
questions.n: To prevent fatigue and improve safety, a landing must be provided for every 3.60m of vertical rise.

questions.q: Under RA 9514, what is the maximum length of a dead-end corridor for an Educational occupancy?
questions.n: For educational facilities, dead ends are strictly limited to 6.00m to ensure students don't get trapped during an emergency.

questions.q: What is the minimum handrail height for stairs according to PD 1096?
questions.n: The NBC requires handrails to be placed between 800mm and 900mm from the tread nosing.

questions.q: Under BP 344, what is the minimum width of a corridor?
questions.n: Corridors must be at least 1.20m wide to allow for the comfortable passage of a wheelchair and a pedestrian.

questions.q: What is the minimum area for a bathroom/toilet according to PD 1096?
questions.n: The NBC sets 1.20 sqm as the absolute minimum area for a bathroom to accommodate essential fixtures.

questions.q: According to PD 1096, how far must a firewall extend above the roof line?
questions.n: The NBC requires a 400mm extension to prevent fire from 'lapping' over the roof and spreading to the adjacent property.

questions.q: What is the occupant load factor for a 'Hotel' under PD 1096?
questions.n: Hotel rooms are designed for lower density, using 18.60 sqm per person for planning exit capacity.

questions.q: Under RA 9514, what is the required minimum width of a 'new' stair for an occupant load of more than 2000?
questions.n: Large occupancy buildings require very wide stairs to facilitate mass evacuation safely.

questions.q: Under RA 9514, what is the maximum travel distance from any point in a building to an exit in an unsprinklered Educational occupancy?
questions.n: For educational spaces without a sprinkler system, 46 meters is the maximum allowable distance to reach a safe exit.

questions.q: According to BP 344, what is the minimum dimension of a turnabout space for wheelchairs (frequently used in corridors or near doors)?
questions.n: A 1.50m square provides the necessary 360-degree turning radius for a standard manual wheelchair.

questions.q: What is the minimum clear width of an aisle in a 'Place of Assembly' serving more than 60 seats under PD 1096?
questions.n: The NBC requires a 1.00m minimum width for aisles to ensure safe egress in assembly areas with significant seating.

questions.q: Under RA 9514, what is the occupant load factor for a 'Detention and Correctional' occupancy?
questions.n: The Fire Code uses this factor to calculate the required exit capacity for prisons and similar facilities.

questions.q: For an R-1 property, what is the minimum required 'Front Setback' according to the National Building Code (PD 1096)?
questions.n: R-1 zoning requires a substantial front setback of 4.50m to allow for driveways and front gardens.

questions.q: What is the minimum height of a 'Guard' (railing) for a balcony under RA 9514 if the height of the fall is more than 76cm?
questions.n: The Fire Code specifies 1066mm (42 inches) for guards to prevent accidental falls from heights.

questions.q: Under BP 220, what is the minimum thickness of a 'Firewall' made of masonry?
questions.n: BP 220 requires a minimum of 150mm for fire-resistive masonry walls used as property separators.

questions.q: According to the NBC (PD 1096), what is the maximum length of a 'Dead-End' corridor in a building provided with an automatic sprinkler system?
questions.n: The NBC allows dead ends to extend to 12 meters only if the building is fully sprinklered.

questions.q: Under BP 344, what is the maximum height of a water closet (toilet seat) from the floor?
questions.n: The range for an accessible toilet seat is 450mm to 500mm to facilitate easier transfers from a wheelchair.

questions.q: What is the occupant load factor for a 'Health Care - Sleeping Departments' under RA 9514?
questions.n: This factor accounts for the large amount of space occupied by hospital beds and medical equipment.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, what is the minimum width of a 'Run' (tread) for a residential stair?
questions.n: The NBC requires at least 250mm for the tread to provide a safe surface for the average adult foot.

questions.q: According to BP 344, what is the required length of the extension for a handrail at the top and bottom of a ramp?
questions.n: Handrails must extend 300mm beyond the start and end of the ramp to provide a tactile cue for users.

questions.q: Under RA 9514, any building with an occupant load of more than 10 but fewer than 500 requires how many exits?
questions.n: Buildings with more than 10 occupants must have at least two separate exits to prevent people from being trapped.

questions.q: What is the minimum dimension of a 'Kitchen' under BP 220 (Economic Housing)?
questions.n: The least dimension for a kitchen in BP 220 is 1.50m to ensure basic movement between counters.

questions.q: According to the NBC, a 'Mezzanine' floor is not considered a storey if it does not exceed what percentage of the floor area below it?
questions.n: If a mezzanine is less than half the area of the room it is in, it's considered an intermediate floor rather than a full storey.

questions.q: Under BP 344, what is the maximum height of a 'Threshold' for a door to be considered accessible?
questions.n: Thresholds must be 25mm or less and should be beveled to allow wheelchair wheels to roll over them.

questions.q: What is the occupant load factor for a 'Mercantile - Street Floor' under RA 9514?
questions.n: Street floors of retail stores are high-traffic areas, requiring a higher density calculation for exits.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, for a building of more than two storeys, what is the minimum fire-resistance rating for the exterior walls?
questions.n: The NBC requires at least a 1-hour fire rating to ensure the structure remains stable during an initial fire response.

questions.q: According to RA 9514, what is the minimum width of a hallway or corridor for an Educational occupancy serving 100 or more occupants?
questions.n: School corridors must be wide enough to handle the surge of students during class changes and emergencies.

questions.q: What is the maximum distance between 'Accessible Parking' slots and the building entrance under BP 344?
questions.n: Accessible parking must be within 60 meters to minimize the distance a person with a disability must travel.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, what is the minimum clear height of a 'Projections' (like a sign or awning) over a public sidewalk?
questions.n: This ensures that pedestrians and maintenance equipment can pass safely underneath without obstruction.

questions.q: According to RA 9514, 'New' exit stairs must have a minimum headroom of how much?
questions.n: Headroom is measured vertically from a plane parallel to the stair nosing to the ceiling above.

questions.q: In a residential house (R-1), what is the minimum required distance between the building and a detached 'Carport'?
questions.n: A 2.00m separation is required unless they are specifically designed to be attached with proper fire protection.

questions.q: Under BP 220, what is the maximum number of storeys allowed for a building without an elevator?
questions.n: Socialized housing allows up to 5 floors without an elevator to keep costs low for residents.

questions.q: According to BP 344, what is the minimum diameter of a 'Handrail' for it to be considered graspable?
questions.n: This range ensures that the handrail can be comfortably and securely gripped by most people.

questions.q: Under RA 9514, what is the maximum distance between exits for an unsprinklered room with an occupant load of more than 50?
questions.n: Exits must be separated by at least half the length of the room's diagonal to ensure one fire can't block both.

questions.q: What is the minimum width of a 'Ramp' for a wheelchair under BP 344?
questions.n: A 1.20m width allows a wheelchair user to travel with enough space for their hands on the rails.

questions.q: According to PD 1096, for a room with an area of 20.00 sqm, what is the minimum required window area for natural ventilation?
questions.n: The NBC requires window openings to be at least 10% of the floor area (20 sqm x 10% = 2.00 sqm).

questions.q: Under RA 9514, what is the 'Occupant Load Factor' for a kitchen in a commercial building?
questions.n: Kitchens are industrial spaces with large equipment, so they use a lower density factor.

questions.q: What is the maximum height of a 'Stair Flight' before a landing is required in BP 220?
questions.n: Like the NBC, socialized housing requires a landing at this height for user safety.

questions.q: Under BP 344, what is the required width of an 'Accessible Parking' slot?
questions.n: This includes the 2.50m parking space and a 1.20m access aisle for wheelchair deployment.

questions.q: According to RA 9514, 'Existing' stairs are allowed to have a maximum riser height of how much?
questions.n: The Fire Code is slightly more lenient with existing stairs, allowing a riser height up to 205mm.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, what is the minimum air space requirement for a 'Workshop' per person?
questions.n: Workshops and factories require 12 cubic meters of air per person to handle potential heat and dust.

questions.q: What is the maximum 'Horizontal Projection' allowed for a balcony over a private court under PD 1096?
questions.n: Balconies can project up to 1.20m as long as they don't impede the required air and light for the court.

questions.q: According to RA 9514, what is the maximum length of a 'Dead-End' corridor in a Business occupancy without a sprinkler system?
questions.n: Business occupancies are allowed longer dead ends than residential or educational ones.

questions.q: Under BP 344, 'Signages' for the visually impaired should be placed at what height from the floor?
questions.n: This height puts the signage at eye level for most people and at a reachable height for tactile reading.

questions.q: What is the minimum 'Clear Width' for a corridor in an R-2 (Residential-2) building according to the NBC?
questions.n: The NBC requires 1.10m for corridors serving more than one dwelling unit to ensure safe passage.

questions.q: According to RA 9514, 'Exit Discharges' (doors leading outside) must be at least how wide?
questions.n: This is the absolute minimum clear width for a single door leaf to be counted as a fire exit.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, what is the minimum required distance of a 'Septic Tank' from any building?
questions.n: This separation protects the building's foundation from moisture and potential leaks.

questions.q: Under BP 220, what is the maximum distance between two 'Multi-Family Dwelling' buildings (Cluster)?
questions.n: BP 220 requires a 4-meter gap between clusters of buildings for light, ventilation, and fire safety.

questions.q: According to RA 9514, 'Illuminated' exit signs must be visible from how far away?
questions.n: The Fire Code requires exit signs to be clearly legible from a distance of 30 meters.

questions.q: Under BP 344, what is the maximum height for an 'Elevator Control' panel?
questions.n: All controls must be within the reach of a person in a wheelchair, which is capped at 1.20m.

questions.q: What is the minimum height of a 'Handrail' for a ramp under BP 344?
questions.n: Accessible ramps require two levels of handrails: one at 900mm and a lower one at 700mm for wheelchair users.

questions.q: According to PD 1096, 'Eaves' may project over a required yard but must maintain a clear distance to the property line of at least?
questions.n: This ensures that fire from one building doesn't immediately ignite the roof of a neighbor's house.

questions.q: Under RA 9514, what is the occupant load factor for an 'Office'?
questions.n: This is the standard density used to determine the exit requirements for business/office spaces.

questions.q: Under BP 220, what is the minimum width of a 'Pathwalk' serving multiple dwellings?
questions.n: Like many other codes, BP 220 uses 1.20m for shared walkways to allow for two-way pedestrian traffic.

questions.q: According to PD 1096, for a room with an area of 12.00 sqm, what is the minimum required window area for natural lighting?
questions.n: The NBC requires window openings to be at least 10% of the floor area for light (12 sqm x 10% = 1.20 sqm).

questions.q: Under RA 9514, 'Staircases' in buildings of 4 storeys or more must have an enclosure with a fire rating of?
questions.n: Taller buildings require more robust exit enclosures because evacuation takes longer.

questions.q: What is the minimum depth of a 'Tactile Surface' (warning tiles) at the top and bottom of a ramp under BP 344?
questions.n: A 600mm tactile strip provides enough of a texture change to be noticed by a visually impaired person.

questions.q: According to PD 1096, what is the minimum floor-to-ceiling height of a 'Mezzanine'?
questions.n: Mezzanines are allowed a lower clear height of 1.80m, reflecting their use as intermediate platforms.

questions.q: Under RA 9514, what is the maximum travel distance to an exit for a sprinklered 'Business' occupancy?
questions.n: The Fire Code allows for an increased travel distance of 61 meters when an automatic sprinkler system is present in business spaces.

questions.q: According to BP 344, what is the minimum clear width of an accessible 'Switch' or 'Control' zone from a corner?
questions.n: Controls must be placed at least 200mm away from any internal corner to ensure a wheelchair user has enough room to reach them.

questions.q: What is the minimum required width for a 'Planting Strip' in a 10.00m wide Right-of-Way (ROW) for a socialized housing project under BP 220?
questions.n: For a 10-meter ROW, BP 220 specifies a 0.40m wide planting strip on each side of the roadway.

questions.q: Under RA 9514, what is the occupant load factor for a 'Library Reading Room'?
questions.n: Reading rooms are calculated with this factor to account for tables, chairs, and the density of users.

questions.q: What is the minimum dimension for the 'Least Side' of a court required for a cluster of R-2 buildings under PD 1096?
questions.n: The NBC requires that any court have a minimum width of 2.00m to ensure adequate light and air to the units.

questions.q: According to BP 344, what is the maximum height of a 'Handrail' for a person with disability?
questions.n: Handrails must be installed between 700mm and 900mm to accommodate different heights and wheelchair users.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, what is the maximum area allowed for a 'Mezzanine' in relation to the main floor area it serves?
questions.n: A mezzanine cannot exceed 50% of the area of the room in which it is located, or it will be counted as a full storey.

questions.q: In RA 9514, what is the required fire-resistance rating for 'Exit Enclosures' in a building 3 storeys high?
questions.n: For buildings less than 4 storeys high, a 1-hour fire rating is required for the protection of exit stairs.

questions.q: Under BP 220, what is the minimum clear width for a 'Door' to a bedroom?
questions.n: Bedroom doors in economic and socialized housing must be at least 0.70m wide to allow for furniture and passage.

questions.q: According to BP 344, 'Tactile' surfaces should be installed at the top and bottom of ramps. What is the standard depth of this warning surface?
questions.n: A 600mm depth ensures that a person using a cane or walking will definitely step on and feel the change in texture.

questions.q: What is the maximum 'Riser' height for a 'New' stair in an assembly occupancy under RA 9514?
questions.n: New stairs in public occupancies are capped at 180mm to ensure they are not too steep for emergency egress.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, what is the minimum required distance of a 'Water Well' from a septic tank?
questions.n: To prevent contamination of drinking water, the NBC mandates a 15-meter separation from sewage disposal systems.

questions.q: What is the 'Occupant Load Factor' for a 'Gymnasium' (as an assembly area without fixed seats) under RA 9514?
questions.n: Gymnasiums used for assembly are calculated with this factor to account for space between people during activities.

questions.q: According to BP 344, what is the minimum clear width of an 'Entrance' or 'Exit' door for accessibility?
questions.n: The Accessibility Law requires 800mm clear width to allow standard wheelchairs to pass through without hitting the frame.

questions.q: Under BP 220, what is the minimum 'Clearance' height for a mezzanine?
questions.n: BP 220 follows the same logic as the NBC, allowing an 1.80m height for mezzanine levels.

questions.q: What is the maximum 'Dead-End' corridor length for a 'Healthcare' occupancy under RA 9514?
questions.n: Because occupants in hospitals may be bed-ridden or slow to move, dead-ends are strictly limited to 6 meters.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, 'Eaves' are permitted to project over a yard provided that they are at least how many millimeters from the side/rear property line?
questions.n: A 750mm (0.75m) gap must be maintained to prevent the roof from potentially spreading fire across property lines.

questions.q: According to BP 344, 'Handrails' must extend horizontally beyond the start and end of a ramp by how many millimeters?
questions.n: The 300mm extension provides a grip for the user before they begin the incline or after they reach the level floor.

questions.q: What is the minimum floor area for a 'Single Family' dwelling unit under BP 220 (Socialized Housing)?
questions.n: Socialized housing units are allowed a minimum area of 18 sqm to keep them affordable while providing basic living space.

questions.q: According to RA 9514, what is the 'Occupant Load Factor' for a 'Dining Area' in a restaurant?
questions.n: Dining areas are calculated with this factor to account for tables and chairs used by patrons.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, what is the minimum required 'Rear Setback' for an R-1 residential property?
questions.n: R-1 properties require a 2.00m rear setback to provide separation from the rear neighbor and allow for drainage.

questions.q: What is the maximum 'Width' allowed for a single 'Stair Flight' before an intermediate handrail is required in an assembly building under RA 9514?
questions.n: If a stair is wider than 2.2 meters, an intermediate handrail must be installed to ensure all users can reach a rail during an emergency.

questions.q: According to BP 344, what is the maximum height for an 'Elevator Button' from the floor?
questions.n: To ensure reachability for a person in a wheelchair, the topmost button cannot exceed 1.20m in height.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, what is the minimum clear height of a 'Carport'?
questions.n: The NBC allows carports to have a clearance of 2.10m, which is sufficient for standard passenger vehicles.

questions.q: What is the minimum dimension for a 'Toilet and Bath' (bathroom) under BP 220?
questions.n: BP 220 allows a narrower least dimension of 0.90m for bathrooms in socialized housing to save space.

questions.q: Under RA 9514, what is the minimum width of an 'Exit Door' serving a room with 50 or more occupants?
questions.n: For high-occupancy rooms, the Fire Code requires a wider door (36 inches) to facilitate rapid egress.

questions.q: According to BP 344, what is the maximum 'Gradient' (slope) for a walkway to not be considered a ramp?
questions.n: Any slope steeper than 1:20 is legally classified as a ramp and must follow ramp rules (handrails, landings).

questions.q: What is the minimum volume of 'Air Space' required for a student in a 'Classroom' under PD 1096?
questions.n: Classrooms have high turnover and frequent ventilation, allowing a lower 3.00 cubic meter per person air requirement.

questions.q: In a residential development (R-1), what is the maximum percentage of the lot that can be covered by the building (Maximum Allowable Construction Area)?
questions.n: For an R-1 interior lot, the NBC limits the building footprint to 70% to ensure 30% remains as open space.

questions.q: Under RA 9514, what is the maximum distance between 'Fire Extinguishers' in a building?
questions.n: To ensure an extinguisher is always within reach, they must be spaced so the travel distance to one is no more than 23 meters.

questions.q: According to BP 344, 'Washbasins' (sinks) in accessible toilets must have a maximum height of how many millimeters?
questions.n: A 800mm height allows a person in a wheelchair to fit their legs underneath while reaching the basin.

questions.q: Under BP 220, what is the minimum required width for a 'Sidewalk' in a subdivision with a 12.00m wide Right-of-Way?
questions.n: For a 12m ROW, BP 220 requires a 1.20m wide sidewalk on both sides of the road.

questions.q: What is the 'Occupant Load Factor' for a 'Mercantile - Upper Floors' under RA 9514?
questions.n: Upper floors of retail stores are less crowded than the street floor, so they are calculated at 5.60 sqm/person.

questions.q: According to PD 1096, 'Firewalls' must extend how many millimeters above the roof line?
questions.n: Extending the firewall 400mm above the roof prevents flames from 'lapping' over and igniting the neighboring roof.

questions.q: Under BP 344, what is the maximum distance between 'Rest Landings' on a long ramp?
questions.n: Wheelchair users need frequent breaks; therefore, a landing must be provided every 6 meters of horizontal ramp length.

questions.q: What is the minimum height of a 'Handrail' for stairs according to PD 1096?
questions.n: The NBC requires handrails to be between 800mm and 900mm from the stair nosing.

questions.q: According to RA 9514, 'New' exit stairs must have a minimum 'Tread' depth of how much?
questions.n: To ensure stability during emergency descent, the Fire Code requires a deeper 280mm tread for new stairs.

questions.q: Under BP 220, what is the maximum distance of a 'Socialized' housing project from a public transportation line?
questions.n: To remain accessible to low-income residents, socialized housing should ideally be within 2km of transport.

questions.q: According to PD 1096, what is the minimum floor area for a 'Bedroom'?
questions.n: The NBC requires bedrooms to be at least 6 sqm with a minimum least dimension of 2.00m.

questions.q: Under BP 344, what is the minimum 'Clear Height' for any obstruction in a walkway (like a hanging sign)?
questions.n: Any overhead obstruction must be at least 2.00m high to prevent people (especially those who are blind) from walking into it.

questions.q: What is the 'Occupant Load Factor' for a 'Storage' area under RA 9514?
questions.n: Storage areas have very few people, so they are calculated with a very high area-per-person factor.

questions.q: According to PD 1096, 'Aisles' in a 'Place of Assembly' must be at least how wide if they serve more than 60 seats?
questions.n: The NBC requires a 1.00m aisle to ensure safe movement for larger crowds in assembly areas.

questions.q: Under BP 220, what is the minimum required 'Ceiling Height' for a mezzanine in economic housing?
questions.n: Economic housing follows the standard rule of 1.80m for mezzanine clearance.

questions.q: According to RA 9514, 'Exit Sign' letters must be at least how high?
questions.n: The Fire Code requires letters to be at least 15cm (6 inches) tall to ensure they are visible even in smoky conditions.

questions.q: Under BP 344, 'Handrails' must have a diameter of how many millimeters?
questions.n: This diameter range allows most people to wrap their hand around the rail for a secure grip.

questions.q: What is the maximum height of a 'Stair Flight' before a landing is required under PD 1096?
questions.n: To prevent fatigue and increase safety, a landing must be provided for every 3.60m of vertical rise.

questions.q: According to RA 9514, 'New' exit stairs must have a minimum 'Headroom' of how much?
questions.n: Headroom is measured vertically from the stair nosing to the lowest obstruction above; 200cm (2.00m) is the minimum.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, for a room with an area of 20.00 sqm, what is the minimum required window area for natural ventilation?
questions.n: The NBC requires a 10% window area for ventilation (10% of 20 sqm = 2.00 sqm).

questions.q: Under BP 220, what is the minimum width of a 'Pathwalk' serving multiple dwelling units?
questions.n: Pathwalks must be at least 1.20m wide to allow for two people to pass or for wheelchair access.

questions.q: According to PD 1096, what is the minimum height of a 'Parapet' wall for a flat roof?
questions.n: Parapets act as guardrails on roofs and must be 1.10m high to prevent falls.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, what is the minimum area required for a habitable room?
questions.n: This is the minimum floor area mandated for rooms intended for human habitation to ensure basic health and comfort.

questions.q: What is the minimum least dimension of a habitable room according to the National Building Code?
questions.n: The code requires that the shortest side of a habitable room must be at least this length to ensure functional use.

questions.q: According to BP 344, what is the minimum width of a curb cut-out?
questions.n: A minimum of 900mm is required to allow a wheelchair to transition from the street to the sidewalk safely.

questions.q: Under RA 9514, which way must exit doors swing if they serve an occupant load of 50 or more?
o: In the direction of exit travel
questions.n: Doors must swing outward to prevent 'crush' situations where the weight of a crowd prevents the door from opening.

questions.q: What is the minimum thickness of a smoke-proof masonry firewall under BP 220?
questions.n: A 15cm thickness is the standard requirement to ensure a fire-resistance rating suitable for separating dwelling units.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, what is the minimum clear ceiling height for the third floor of a naturally ventilated building?
questions.n: For buildings with more than one story, the floors above the ground floor can have a slightly lower minimum height.

questions.q: What is the minimum required width for a hallway in a single-family dwelling under PD 1096?
questions.n: The code mandates 900mm to ensure enough space for two people to pass or for moving furniture.

questions.q: According to BP 344, what is the maximum height of a light switch from the floor?
questions.n: Switches must be within this reach range to ensure accessibility for individuals with limited mobility.

questions.q: What is the minimum area for a kitchen under BP 220 (Socialized Housing)?
questions.n: BP 220 allows for a very compact kitchen area to make housing more affordable.

questions.q: Under RA 9514, what is the minimum number of exits for any room with an occupant load of 50 or more?
questions.n: The Fire Code mandates at least two separate exits to ensure an alternative path if one is blocked.

questions.q: What is the minimum width of a stair for a building with an occupant load of less than 10?
questions.n: For very small occupant loads in private settings, the code allows for a narrower stair width.

questions.q: According to PD 1096, what is the minimum required size for a window in a bathroom?
questions.n: Bathrooms require less natural light/ventilation than habitable rooms, which require 1/10.

questions.q: Under BP 344, what is the color of the international symbol of access (wheelchair logo)?
questions.n: White symbols on a blue background are the internationally recognized colors for accessibility.

questions.q: What is the minimum tread depth for stairs in a residential (R-1) dwelling under PD 1096?
questions.n: 250mm is the minimum 'run' allowed for residential stairs to ensure safe footing.

questions.q: Under RA 9514, what is the maximum height of a fire extinguisher from the floor if it weighs less than 18kg?
questions.n: Lightweight extinguishers can be mounted up to 1.5 meters high for easy visibility and access.

questions.q: According to BP 220, what is the minimum width of a main door for a housing unit?
questions.n: BP 220 allows for a slightly narrower main door than the standard 900mm in the NBCP.

questions.n: Rooms with artificial ventilation can have lower ceilings because they don't rely on vertical air volume for cooling.

questions.q: Under BP 344, how long must a level area (landing) be at the top and bottom of a ramp?
questions.n: A 1.50m landing provides enough space for a wheelchair to turn or stop safely before or after the slope.

questions.q: According to RA 9514, what is the maximum travel distance to an exit in an unsprinklered 'Mercantile' occupancy?
questions.n: This is the standard maximum travel distance for many occupancies when a sprinkler system is absent.

questions.q: What is the minimum area for a Toilet and Bath under the National Building Code?
questions.n: 1.20 sqm is the legal minimum to accommodate a water closet and a shower/lavatory.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, what is the minimum required distance for a septic tank from a water source (well)?
questions.n: The code requires a 15-meter buffer to prevent sewage from leaching into the groundwater used for drinking.

questions.q: According to BP 344, what is the minimum clearance between a handrail and the wall it is attached to?
questions.n: A 50mm (5cm) gap is required to ensure the handrail can be grasped firmly and safely.

questions.q: In RA 9514, what is the term for a continuous and unobstructed way of exit travel from any point in a building to a public way?
questions.n: The Means of Egress consists of three parts: the exit access, the exit, and the exit discharge.

questions.q: Under BP 220, what is the maximum number of row-house units in a single block or cluster?
questions.n: To prevent excessive density and fire risk, the code limits row houses to 20 units per block.

questions.q: What is the minimum height of a guardrail (railing) for a staircase in a residential house?
questions.n: This is the minimum height allowed for a handrail, which also serves as a guard in many homes.

questions.q: According to BP 344, what is the minimum size of an elevator car to be considered accessible?
questions.n: This dimension ensures a wheelchair can enter and there is room for another person or a maneuver.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, what is the minimum floor area for a single-occupancy unit in a residential condominium (studio)?
questions.n: This is the standard minimum area for a studio-type unit to ensure basic habitability.

questions.q: According to RA 9514, what is the maximum riser height for 'new' stairs?
questions.n: The Fire Code is stricter than the Building Code to ensure safe and fast evacuation during an emergency.

questions.q: What is the minimum width of a walkway to allow two wheelchairs to pass each other comfortably (BP 344)?
questions.n: 1.50m is the minimum width required to allow two wheelchairs to pass or for one to turn.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, which of the following is NOT a required setback for an R-1 property?
questions.n: The term 'setback' applies to the building footprint on the ground, not to roof levels.

questions.q: What is the minimum ceiling height for a mezzanine under BP 220?
questions.n: Both BP 220 and the NBCP allow for a 1.80m height for mezzanines to maximize vertical space.

questions.q: According to PD 1096, what is the maximum height of a building in a residential R-1 zone?
questions.n: R-1 zones are strictly low-density and are limited to 3 storeys (or 10 meters).

questions.q: Under RA 9514, what is the minimum width of an aisle in a 'Place of Assembly'?
questions.n: Assembly areas require at least 1 meter width for aisles to ensure safe egress from seating areas.

questions.q: According to BP 344, what is the maximum allowable pressure required to open an accessible door?
questions.n: Doors must be easy enough for someone with limited strength to open without excessive effort.

questions.q: What is the minimum volume of air space required for a person in a dining room under PD 1096?
questions.n: This is the requirement for habitable rooms like dining and living areas.

questions.q: Under BP 220, what is the minimum required distance of a 'Front Setback' for a socialized housing project?
questions.n: Socialized housing allows for smaller setbacks to maximize the use of small lots.

questions.q: According to RA 9514, what is the maximum distance between exits for an unsprinklered room with more than 50 people?
questions.n: Exits must be separated by at least half the diagonal distance of the area to prevent both being blocked by a single fire.

questions.q: What is the minimum width of an accessible toilet booth under BP 344?
questions.n: An accessible booth must be at least 1.70m wide to allow a wheelchair to be positioned beside the toilet.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, what is the minimum required width for a public sidewalk on a 20.00m wide Road Right-of-Way?
questions.n: The code uses a proportional rule where the sidewalk width depends on the total road width.

questions.q: According to BP 220, what is the minimum distance between two multi-family buildings (cluster)?
questions.n: A 4-meter gap is required between separate building clusters to provide light, air, and fire separation.

questions.q: In the Fire Code (RA 9514), what is the occupant load factor for a 'Waiting Room' (Assembly)?
questions.n: Waiting rooms are extremely dense, requiring only 0.28 sqm per person to account for a standing crowd.

questions.q: What is the minimum height of a door for an accessible toilet under BP 344?
questions.n: 2.00m is the standard minimum height for all main and accessible doors.

questions.q: Under PD 1096, what is the maximum vertical distance between stair landings?
questions.n: Landings are required at every 3.6 meters of vertical rise to ensure users don't become overly fatigued.

questions.q: According to BP 220, what is the minimum floor area for an 'Economic Housing' unit?
questions.n: Economic housing requires at least 22 sqm of floor area per unit.

questions.q: Under RA 9514, what is the maximum length of a dead-end corridor in a 'Business' occupancy with a sprinkler system?
questions.n: For sprinklered business buildings, the dead-end limit is significantly extended to 15 meters.

questions.q: What is the minimum height of a firewall extension above the roofline according to PD 1096?
questions.n: A 40cm extension is required to act as a fire break above the combustible roof materials.

questions.q: Under BP 344, what is the minimum clear width of an accessible corridor?
questions.n: 1.20m allows a wheelchair user to move comfortably and have enough space for their hands on the wheels.

questions.q: According to PD 1096, what is the minimum distance between a septic tank and any property line?
questions.n: 1.00m is the requirement to prevent leaching and structural interference with the neighbor's property.

questions.q: In BP 220, what is the minimum required width for a 'Carport'?
questions.n: A 2.50m width is the standard minimum for a single-car parking space or carport.

questions.q: According to RA 9514, what is the occupant load factor for a 'Library Reading Room'?
questions.n: Reading rooms have a moderate density due to large tables and bookshelves.
